description: This file implements a concurrent Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with a three-segment (hot, warm, cold) eviction policy. It manages cache items efficiently without global locks, using concurrent data structures and sophisticated cycling mechanisms to maintain cache capacity and recency ordering. The class supports typical cache operations such as add, get, remove, and trim, along with internal policies for cycling items between segments based on access patterns.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCache<K, V>
classes.description: A thread-safe, segmented LRU cache implementing a TU-Q eviction policy with hot, warm, and cold segments, designed for high concurrency environments. Supports cache operations and internal cycling for capacity management.

classes.name: LruItem
classes.description: Internal representation of a cache item, including key, value, access and removal flags, with sequence locking for thread safety.

classes.name: TelemetryPolicy
classes.description: Aggregates cache metrics such as hits, misses, evictions, and updates to monitor cache performance.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, throwing if not found.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a value for a key, returning true if found.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add a new key-value pair to the cache.

methods.name: GetOrAdd
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key or adds it using a factory if missing.

methods.name: TryRemove
methods.description: Attempts to remove a key and its value from the cache.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new key-value or updates existing one.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the cache.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Removes a specified number of least recently used items.
